description: This file is a PHP source code defining the ShippingAddress class within the Opencart	est older that extends the system engine controller and handles checkout shipping address functionalities, including viewing, saving, and address management.

classes.name: ShippingAddress
classes.description: A controller class managing the checkout shipping address process, including displaying the address form, saving address data, and retrieving specific addresses during the checkout process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping address form, populates data such as addresses, countries, and session data, and renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submitted shipping address form, validates input, creates or retrieves address data, updates session info, and clears related session data.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Retrieves specific address details based on address ID for the checkout process.
